facts.fact: The Family Code as amended by Law 16/008 of 15 July 2016 has every birth, marriage and death entered as an act in a separate bound register whose blank leaves are numbered and initialled by the public prosecutor's officer, written out without gaps or abbreviations and closed by the civil-status officer at each year's end (Arts. 82-84); the captured articles provide for no electronic record.

systems.country_label: registre de naissance, de mariage, de décès; registre supplétoire
systems.owner: Officier de l'état civil: mayor, bourgmestre of the commune, chief of the secteur or chefferie, head of diplomatic or consular mission; or a State agent named by the provincial governor
systems.tiers: Bureau principal at the seat of each commune, secteur or chefferie; bureaux secondaires created by the provincial governor; a named officer may be posted to a groupement, a health zone or a reference hospital

note: The capture is an excerpt ending in Art. 84; the Code's later civil-status articles were not read because they are not in the file.
